==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
Before I went to sleep, I reread an excerpt from a research paper I had skimmed years ago. The paper talked about the concept of a high lucid dream. The idea is that if you dream about taking a psychedelic, you can experience a trip without actually taking anything.

While falling asleep I primed myself with visualizations of consuming different tablets. In my dream I saw voids of flashing colors, floating shards of stained glass, massive faces, and aggressive shadows. The glass felt like it was a part of me.

I had a couple of false awakenings in which I saw my girlfriend, Ashley, wake me up twice during this experience. Both times I felt like I was violently tumbling downward through the stain glass shards. The experience overall was rather intense.
